notes: I found the box is roughly piecewise quadratic: for x ≥ 0, y ≈ 1.975x² + 56.1x; for x < 0, y ≈ 1.987x² + 40.8x; and for |x| below a small threshold (~18), it saturates at the constant −20.4469. The fits match all observed points within a few percent (the threshold boundary is my best guess, marked uncertain).
